title: Choosing How Much Does Digital Marketing Cost for Remodeling company? 2027 Pricing Guide - A Practical Guide
html:
Use this guide to compare scope, relevant experience, ownership of your accounts and the way a prospective partner measures enquiries. Ask for evidence that matches your service and market, and agree on deliverables before signing a proposal. The focus is on evaluation criteria and questions for an agency proposal.

Digital marketing for remodeling companies typically costs between $2,500 and $10,000 per month for agency management fees, plus $2,000 to $15,000 in direct ad spend. The exact amount depends on your target market, annual revenue, and growth goals. A firm generating under $1 million annually might spend $2,000 a month focusing heavily on local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. A $5 million design-build company requires larger budgets for multi-county Google Ads and custom video assets. Your budget should include lead generation, website management, and SEO to build long-term local authority.

Why Remodeling Companies Need Specialized Digital Marketing

Homeowners do not hire a remodeler for a $75,000 kitchen addition on impulse. They research multiple firms, read Google reviews, and scrutinize past project photos. Generic marketing fails because it treats a massive home addition the same as a $150 emergency plumbing repair. A specialized approach targets the specific ZIP codes where high-net-worth homeowners live.

ROI Section Table

Understanding your return on investment requires looking at your average project margin. The table below illustrates a hypothetical scenario for a remodeling firm closing mid-range kitchen and bath projects.

(Note: These figures are hypothetical and vary by local market, sales process, and competition.)

Cost Per Lead Comparison Against Other Channels

Compare digital marketing directly against other lead sources to see where your budget works hardest. When you buy leads from shared platforms like HomeAdvisor, you compete with three other contractors on price alone.

DIY vs. In-House vs. Agency

  • Annual Cost: $0 in labor, ad spend varies.

  • Pros: No management fees.

  • Cons: You lack the time to optimize negative keyword lists or update schema markup. You risk wasting thousands on poorly targeted Google Ads.

In-House Hire:

  • Annual Cost: $65,000 to $95,000 plus benefits and software.

  • Pros: Dedicated attention to your brand.

  • Cons: One person rarely possesses expert-level skills in SEO, media buying, web design, and conversion tracking.

Plan Your Marketing Budget

Want to know how many leads you need to hit your revenue targets this year? Start with your average job value, profit, and close rate, then set your marketing budget from there.

What is a good marketing budget for a $2 million remodeling firm?

A firm of this size should allocate between $6,500 and $13,500 per month in total marketing spend, splitting funds between agency management and direct ad spend.
